auth.aside.body: One account, every competition on the board, and tools that keep betting in its place. This build is a demonstration — nothing here handles money.
auth.aside.demoNotice: No account is created, no password is stored, and no identity or age check takes place. Do not enter real personal data.
auth.field.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with upper case, lower case and a digit
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.login.description: Pick up where you left off.
auth.register.title: Create an account
auth.register.description: It takes a minute. You must be of legal age.
auth.register.submitted: Form validated. No account was created — this is a demonstration, and a real sign-up would now require email confirmation and identity verification before the account could be used.
auth.forgot.title: Reset your password
auth.forgot.description: Enter your email address and we would send you a reset link.
auth.forgot.submitted: If that address has an account, a reset link would be sent. No email is sent in this demonstration.
auth.age.heading: Age restriction
auth.age.confirm: I confirm that I am {age} years of age or older
auth.age.notVerification: This is a self-declaration, not age verification. A licensed provider must confirm your date of birth against an authoritative source before any account could place a real bet or make a deposit.
auth.validation.ageConfirmRequired: You must confirm you are of legal age
auth.validation.dobInvalid: That is not a valid date
auth.validation.dobUnderage: You must be of legal age to register
auth.validation.emailTooLong: That email address is too long
auth.validation.nameInvalid: Use letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only
auth.validation.passwordContainsEmail: Your password must not contain your email address
auth.validation.passwordNeedsLower: Add at least one lower-case letter
auth.validation.passwordNeedsUpper: Add at least one upper-case letter
auth.validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters
auth.validation.passwordUnchanged: Choose a password you have not used here before
auth.validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Tunisian phone number
auth.validation.tokenInvalid: That reset link is not valid
auth.error.insufficientRole: You do not have access to this area
